ideas.title: Bogged: the yacht sinks into the beach you sail it onto, and you dig it out with your own beak
ideas.goal: In Jump in, steer the yacht off the wet band into dry sand and it really bogs: the wheels sink and stop where the sand says. Get it out the way people do on a real beach: dig in front of a wheel (every scoop you take lands where you throw it), call a friend whose feet can only push as hard as the sand under them holds, rock it back and forth in its own ruts, or drop a plank. Every way works anywhere on the beach and in any mix, because none of them is a button: the solver decides if it rolls.
ideas.toward: Wheels, frame and sand of the road (the cart's own resistance, the plank road) and the big goal's moment of friends getting off to push.
ideas.idea: Not a patch around one cart: the beach's sand field wakes in tiles wherever a body presses it (the yacht's wheels by Bekker with their load history, Lumi's and the friends' feet with their real weight) and goes back to sleep when nothing is there. Digging is Lumi's beak/scoop removing a volume of cells in front of it and dropping that same volume where Lumi turns (mass kept), then the field slumps to repose: a ramp, a trench or a pile, whatever you dug. A friend pushing is a body in contact with the stern; its push is capped by the Mohr-Coulomb shear its own feet get in the sand (dry sand slips, a plank holds), and its feet leave furrows. Rocking works by momentum against the berm the wheel pushed up. Someone watching sees the yacht slow and settle, a wheel half buried, Lumi digging, sand landing in a heap, a pony's feet churning, and the yacht lurching free.
ideas.form: Plugin in the land yacht's Jump in on the beach's own sand; a path traced short at dusk: bog, dig, push, out.

ideas.title: Quicksand at the stream mouth: stamp and the ground turns to liquid
ideas.goal: Where the stream meets the beach the sand is soaked. Walk on it and it holds; stamp, jump or roll a cart over it and it turns soupy, swallows feet and wheels, and sets again once you stand still, holding you fast. Players learn to cross it slowly, lay planks or lure a friend in. It is a place to dare each other.
ideas.toward: The cart's route along the beach: where its wheels can and cannot go, and why the planks matter.
ideas.idea: Saturated sand with pore pressure: each shake (a body's impact, a wheel's load cycle) raises pore pressure in the cells under it, effective stress drops, the Mohr-Coulomb strength with it, and the field flows like a heavy liquid; the pressure drains with time and the sand locks again around whatever sank. Feet and wheels sink by buoyancy in the liquefied mix (density ~2000 kg/m3). Watchers see a friend sink to the knees after a jump and wriggle out slowly.
ideas.form: Physics module on the sand field + plugin at the stream mouth; traced short of a friend sinking and being pulled out.

ideas.title: Haul it out: the friends on a rope against the sand
ideas.goal: When the yacht is bogged, tie a rope to its bow and call the friends: they line up and pull; their feet dig and slide in dry sand and hold on the wet band, so where they stand decides if it moves. Too few, or on the wrong sand, and they fall on their bottoms.
ideas.toward: The friends pull the cart (project cart.md) and the moment's friends pushing it the last plank.
ideas.idea: The rope as a chain of segments on the body solver; each friend's pull limited by Bekker/Mohr-Coulomb shear of its feet in the field under its weight; the yacht's resistance from its wheels in the same field. A friend whose feet slip falls over (a ragdoll moment).
ideas.form: Plugin in Jump in; short of the friends falling in a heap and then hauling it free.
